steps.title: Delimit the sampling area
steps.instruction: Establish a 1000 m² (50m x 20m) area within a 0.7 hectare banana cultivation site using a tape measure.

substeps.instruction: Divide the study plot into 5 subplots, each measuring 10 m² x 20 m².
Use a wooden frame (20 cm long x 20 cm wide) to mark the extraction point.

steps.title: Extract litter and soil
steps.instruction: Collect a soil column from 0-20 cm and leaf litter using the 20 cm x 20 cm wooden frame.

substeps.instruction: Place the wooden frame on the ground.
Use a shovel to border the outside of the frame to delimit the litter block and soil column (0-20 cm).
Surround each side with plastic mesh to prevent soil fauna from escaping.
Obtain an approximate weight of 1 kilogram of soil, divided into two successive strata (leaf litter and 0-20 cm soil).

steps.title: Sieve samples and separate macrofauna
steps.instruction: Sieve the collected litter and soil (0-20 cm) using a 20 mesh x inch² sieve.

substeps.instruction: Manually separate the macrofauna from soil, clods, roots, twigs, and stones.

steps.title: Collect and preserve specimens
steps.instruction: Place separated macrofauna into labeled and coded airtight plastic jars (500 cubic centimeters in volume).

steps.title: Transfer samples to laboratory
steps.instruction: Transport the labeled and coded containers to the Entomology Laboratory of the Agroecology Department of UNAN-León, ensuring samples are protected from the sun.

steps.title: Identify macrofauna
steps.instruction: Quantify and identify organisms (length > 4 mm) by order, family, and gender using invertebrate identification manuals.

substeps.instruction: Place organisms in a Petri dish.
Observe structures using a 4x binocular stereoscope.
Separate each individual into a bottle based on origin, sample number, and biological classification.

steps.title: Analyze richness and diversity indices
steps.instruction: Analyze species diversity and richness using the following indices: Richness (number of species), Relative abundance (Density number of individuals 1 m² for each species), Functional Groups (Density number of individuals 1 m² for each species), Shannon-Wiener Index (SW), Margalef Diversity Index, Proportional abundance indices, Dominance indices (Simpson index), and Equity indices (Pielou index).

steps.title: Record fruit yield
steps.instruction: Record the total number of fingers per hectare using data provided by the producer from farm records.
